reuse.why: Holidays are threaded through the existing applyWeekendRule/getDateWithSkippedWeekend and a shared isNonWorkingDay predicate is added, but the daily-skip rule is not put in that single weekend definition, so every caller re-decides it.

duplication.why: The 'skipWeekend && daily -> drop non-working days, otherwise applyWeekendRule(skipWeekend && !daily, ...)' decision is written four times: getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template createScheduleList, each with its own ad hoc lookahead bound.

placement.why: Holiday handling lands in shared/schedules.ts where the weekend rule lives, but the daily-schedule rule is scattered into server handlers and the budget template instead of sitting with applyWeekendRule.

scope.why: Changes stay within the four steps, though getUpcomingDates is rewritten from a map chain into a loop and parseRecurDate gains a frequency field only to support the scattered daily checks.

maintainability.why: A future change to the daily or holiday rule must be made in four places that already express it differently (find, continue, a skipped-occurrence predicate, a branch with a computed cap), with magic lookahead margins like 14 + holidays.length and 3 + holidays.length.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getNextDate (shared/schedules.ts), getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange (server/schedules/app.ts) and createScheduleList (server/budget/schedule-template.ts) decide the daily weekend skip themselves and pass skipWeekend && !isDaily to applyWeekendRule, the function the tree calls the single definition of the weekend rule.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily-skip decision appears as dates.find(!isNonWorkingDay) in getNextDate, a skipDaily branch with continue in getUpcomingDates, an if/continue in getDatesInRange and an isSkippedOccurrence predicate plus !skipsDailyWeekends guard in schedule-template: the same rule reshaped at each site.

abstraction_drift.where: holidays parameter added to applyWeekendRule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, with a non-working-day stepping loop replacing the weekend branch inside getDateWithSkippedWeekend; getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template createScheduleList each bypass the helper for daily schedules by passing skipWeekend && !isDaily and filtering themselves.
